SPIREOFFACTORIO-SCORCH_POWER.title: Scorch
SPIREOFFACTORIO-SCORCH_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, take damage, then lose half of the stacks of this debuff. Debuff is removed if fewer than 5 stacks are present.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-SCORCH_POWER.smartDescri: At the start of your turn, take [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage, then lose half of the stacks of this debuff. Debuff is removed if fewer than 5 stacks are present.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-SHOCK_POWER.title: Shock
SPIREOFFACTORIO-SHOCK_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, there is a chance to be [gold]Stunned[/gold]. Stacks are lost if no additional stacks are gained next turn, or [gold]Stunned[/gold] is applied.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-SHOCK_POWER.smartDescrip: At the start of your turn, there is a [blue]{StunPercent}[/blue]% chance to be [gold]Stunned[/gold]. Stacks are lost if no additional stacks are gained next turn, or [gold]Stunned[/gold] is applied.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-OVERCLOCK_POWER.title: Overclock
SPIREOFFACTORIO-OVERCLOCK_POWER.descript: This construct is amplified, with output values increased. When the construct performs an action, you gain [gold]Overload[/gold], and the construct loses one stack of [gold]Overclock[/gold].
SPIREOFFACTORIO-OVERCLOCK_POWER.smartDes: This construct is amplified, with output values increased by [blue]{Percent}[/blue]%. When the construct performs an action, you gain [gold]Overload[/gold], and the construct loses one stack of [gold]Overclock[/gold].
SPIREOFFACTORIO-DISABLED_POWER.title: Disabled
SPIREOFFACTORIO-DISABLED_POWER.descripti: This construct is disabled and cannot perform actions this turn. One stack is lost each turn.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-DISABLED_POWER.smartDesc: This construct is disabled and cannot perform actions for [blue]{Amount}[/blue] turn{Amount:plural:|s}.
